overview: All-Star Music is a Value resort themed to music, with giant instruments and jukeboxes around the courtyards. It's the All-Star resort with Family Suites, which makes it popular with bigger families.
suits: Families on a budget, especially groups of five or six who want a Family Suite instead of two rooms.
rooms:
Standard rooms are compact and sleep up to four, with two queen beds or one queen plus a pull-down bed in refreshed rooms. Check the latest room setup when you book.

Family Suites sleep up to six, with a separate bedroom, two bathrooms and a kitchenette.
pools: The guitar-shaped Calypso Pool is the main pool, and the Piano Pool is the quieter second option.
dining: Dining is the Intermission Food Court plus a pool bar. There's no table-service restaurant on site.
gettingAround: Every park is reached by Disney bus.
pros: Family Suites at a Value-level resort
Low price for a Disney-owned hotel
cons: Can be busy and loud around the pools
tips: If you book a Family Suite, compare its price against two standard rooms; sometimes the suite is the better deal.
Mobile order from the food court to skip the line at breakfast.
bestFor: Budget-minded families, especially groups of five or six.
